invariants.rationale: draw depends on 'batch' being valid; common for rendering APIs to require a non-null Batch.
Alpha values (opacity) are generally clamped to non-negative values (0 = fully transparent).
Alpha blending factors are typically expected to be in the [0,1] range.
getColor() is accessed in draw, so it is expected to not return null.
Widget dimensions (like width) are expected to be non-negative for rendering.
